title: FocusOPD: Structure-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models
title_zh: FocusOPD：基于结构的扩散模型在线策略蒸馏

paragraphs.en: FocusOPD通过改进特征对齐机制，提高了任务特定能力的迁移效果。 Multi-teacher on-policy distillation enables rectified-flow models with diffusion-transformer architectures to combine task-specific capabilities within a single student. However, matching model outputs does not guarantee that their internal representations are aligned, and it remains unclear where and when additional feature supervision is most useful. We analyze the teacher-student feature mismatch across Transformer blocks and denoising timesteps, and find that the mismatch is concentrated in deeper Transformer blocks during early denoising and persists after OPD distillation, indicating ineffective distillation. Motivated by this observation, we introduce FocusOPD, which augments the base OPD objective with token-wise directional feature alignment restricted to deep layers and early denoising steps. Across two rectified-flow backbones and multiple OPD objectives, FocusOPD improves capability transfer in compositional generation, text rendering, and preference-based evaluation. On the primary benchmark, it improves over DiffusionOPD from 0.953 to 0.967 on GenEval, from 23.797 to 23.944 on PickScore, and from 6.052 to 6.199 on LAION-Aesthetic. Ablations show that selective deep and early supervision is more effective and efficient than alignment over the full network and trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: FocusOPD 通过改进特征对齐机制，提升了任务特定能力的迁移效果。多教师在线策略蒸馏使采用扩散-Transformer 架构的整流流模型能够在单个学生模型中结合多种任务特定能力。 然而，匹配模型输出并不能保证其内部表示是对齐的，而且目前仍不清楚在何处以及何时提供额外的特征监督最为有用。 我们分析了 Transformer 块和去噪时间步之间的师生特征失配，发现失配集中在早期去噪时较深的 Transformer 块中，并且在 OPD 蒸馏后仍然存在，表明蒸馏效果不佳。 基于这一观察，我们提出了 FocusOPD，它在基础 OPD 目标之上，增加了仅限于深层和早期去噪步骤的逐 token 方向性特征对齐。 在两个整流流骨干网络和多种 OPD 目标上，FocusOPD 在组合生成、文本渲染和基于偏好的评估中提升了能力迁移效果。 在主要基准上，相比 DiffusionOPD，它将 GenEval 从 0.953 提升到 0.967，PickScore 从 23.797 提升到 23.944，LAION-Aesthetic 从 6.052 提升到 6.199。 消融实验表明，选择性的深层和早期监督比对整个网络和轨迹进行对齐更有效也更高效。
